label: Laserium opens at Griffith Observatory
detail: Ivan Dryer's laser show opens in Los Angeles and runs there for nearly three decades.

label: First multicolor laser moving head
detail: LOBO dates its ZAPHIR, a scanned laser in a moving-head fixture, to this year.

label: Tupac "hologram" at Coachella
detail: A 2D projection reflected off a slanted transparent film - Pepper's ghost; the vendor's CEO said it was not holographic.

label: Lasers as lighting fixtures
detail: PLSN describes the push to run scanned lasers from standard lighting consoles like any other fixture.

label: Laser-source searchlight reported
detail: Claypaky's Skylos uses a 300 W white laser source; the maker claims output equal to a 4,000 W xenon lamp.
